review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped the project for uses of awayMapOfIsUnit and for @[simp] attributes. The file declares no simp lemmas, and all its proofs use simp only or rw. I found no unwanted expansion, no competing rules and no credible cycle. The only simp-interface gap I found is that awayMapOfIsUnit has no characterising rewrite lemma. This is a modest issue. I did not run Lean, so I don't know whether the proposed lemma would be needed by a particular simp call. I did not open the Mathlib lemma statements for IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp.

findings.problem: awayMapOfIsUnit is a plain def. The only lemma about it, awayMapOfIsUnit_mk_spec, states `f a = (f t)^k * awayMapOfIsUnit ...`. That form puts the opaque map on the right side and has a non-trivial left side, so it cannot serve as a rewrite or simp rule. There is no lemma giving its defining composition with the algebraMap from Away 𝒜 t into Localization.Away t. There is also no lemma for how it interacts with composition by a ring hom. Because of this, later proofs unfold the definition. `unfold chartSectionMap awayMapOfIsUnit` appears in chartSectionMap_eq_awayMap, and the proof of awayMapOfIsUnit_mk_spec runs `simpa only [awayMapOfIsUnit, RingHom.comp_apply, ...]`. They then redo the RingHom.comp_assoc and IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp bookkeeping by hand. The unfolding exposes the `IsLocalization.Away.lift` implementation detail at every use.
findings.proposed_change: Add a lemma such as `awayMapOfIsUnit_comp_algebraMap : (awayMapOfIsUnit 𝒜 f hunit).comp (algebraMap (Away 𝒜 t) (Localization.Away t)) = IsLocalization.Away.lift t hunit`. Mark it `@[simp]` only if the Lean statement keeps awayMapOfIsUnit folded, so simp does not unfold it. A pointwise `awayMapOfIsUnit_apply_algebraMap` variant would also be useful. Then chartSectionMap_eq_awayMap and awayMapOfIsUnit_mk_spec can rewrite with this lemma and no longer need `unfold awayMapOfIsUnit`. A companion lemma `awayMapOfIsUnit_mk_mul_pow`, with the orientation `(f t)^k * awayMapOfIsUnit … (Away.mk …) = f a`, would be a better-directed rewrite rule than the current spec.
findings.benefit: The definition stays opaque to clients. Proofs about charts can use short rewrites in place of unfold-and-comp_assoc scripts. Proofs of chart equalities also become less likely to break if the definition is refactored.
